purpose: Turn real diagnostics into a genuine model-authored repair plan (summary + actions drawn only from the repair-engine catalogue, referencing the actual diagnostics) OR an explicit unavailable status. Never a heuristic plan presented as the AI plan. Structurally kills Manifest I2 and C3.

capabilities.name: author_plan
capabilities.function: Build a prompt from diagnostics; the model selects only from the repair-engine catalogue; return summary + actions + provenance.

capabilities.name: provider_order
capabilities.function: local-model-satellite (if attached) -> Azure OpenAI -> Gemini, via the llm-portal.

capabilities.name: honest_unavailable
capabilities.function: If every provider fails, return status:unavailable with a reason. There is no code path that emits a heuristic plan under status:ok.

capabilities.name: catalogue_integrity
capabilities.function: Every emitted action.id is a member of the prontopc-repair-engine catalogue, so plan and engine cannot drift.

expected_outputs: status:ok plan that references the supplied diagnostics (disk/memory/temp/etc.)
provenance.provider + provenance.model present on every ok plan
with all providers forced down: status:unavailable, never a heuristic plan
